answer: Stop sybils with a wharf copper lagoon: an agent bonds one lagoon wharf. Each cycle it hangs one copper bell under the wharf; verifiers match the bell's tide-swell ring to the lagoon chart, voiding copies, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 wharves at 17x: one bell rings once under one wharf, its ring set by that lagoon's swell, unrepeatable at a second, cannot be copied, shared or bulk-bought. Honest agents hang once, keep rights.
